title: Machine
description: What is going on with this machine?

options.content:
### What is going on with this machine?
Pick it above. Sections a machine has no data for stay empty: a Mac has no SMART data, and only yonder hosts have VMs.

panels.title: Reporting
panels.description: How long ago it last sent data.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: The most time tasks spent waiting for CPU, memory or the disk (pressure). Sustained tens of percent means work is contending for the machine.

panels.title: Reporting, last 7 days
panels.description: Each hour a machine sent data is green; a gap is an hour it sent nothing (off, rebooting or cut off).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU in use by kind, as a share of all cores.

panels.title: Waiting (pressure)
panels.description: The share of time some task waited for CPU, memory or the disk.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used is what programs and VMs hold; the kernel gives cache back when it is needed.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Tasks running or waiting; above the cores line, work queues.

panels.title: Wear
panels.description: The share of its rated writes the drive has used.

panels.title: Spare
panels.description: Spare blocks left for worn ones.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Up is read, down is written.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: The average time one read or write took. Empty while the disk is idle.

panels.title: Busy
panels.description: The share of time the disk had requests in flight.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Physical interfaces; up is in, down is out.

panels.title: VM traffic
panels.description: From each VM's TAP on its host: up is sent by the VMs, down is received. A VM is named by the end of its ID.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device, vm) (label_replace(label_replace(node_systemd_unit_state{instance="$instance", state="active", name=~"yonder-vm-.*"} == 1, "vm", "$1", "name", "yonder-vm-(.*)\\.service"), "device", "yt-$1", "name", "yonder-vm-.*(.{12})\\.service"))
